name: Hohoemi o Mou Ichido ~Smile Again~
original_name: 微笑みをもういちど ～smile again～
source:
Due to his parents’ job transfer, the protagonist is set to move overseas by the end of the year. With only a short time left, he struggles to confess his feelings to those he cares about.
Five years later, he returns to Japan, and a new chapter of his life begins.

--Student Arc
Four childhood friends—Yuka, Haruna, Hideo, and the protagonist—have always been inseparable. But their time together is about to come to an end.
Because of family circumstances, the protagonist has to move abroad.

In the little time he has left, he works tirelessly to nurture his friendships and express his feelings. Along the way, new encounters spark new emotions.
The protagonist’s actions will drastically change the futures of the girls around him. Whether those actions were right or wrong, no one can say for sure.

And so, with a heart full of mixed emotions, the protagonist leaves Japan…

--Adult Arc
Five years later, the protagonist returns to his hometown as a lecturer at his alma mater. He reunites with his old friends, who have all taken different paths in life.

Now adults, they each carry burdens and struggles that they can’t share with others. The passage of time has also created a wall between the protagonist and his friends.
Amidst this, the protagonist strives to rebuild his connections with them and find love once more.

The story captures the joys, sorrows, regrets, and setbacks of youth—and the resilience it takes to move forward in life.
